Every workbook TARIN reads is kept, and a figure the World Bank revises is kept beside the new one.

rules.mom_consistency: Month-on-month rate doesn't match the change in the index
rules.yoy_consistency: Year-on-year rate doesn't match the change in the index
rules.rebase_discontinuity: Index and rate disagree sharply at a possible series break
rules.unconfirmed_break: A recorded series break not yet confirmed
rules.aggregation: Weighted parts don't add up to the published total
rules.regional_nonfood: Disagrees with Non-food rebuilt from the annex's product groups
rules.same_month_copy: Two product groups publish the same value this month
rules.annex3_vs_annex4: Annex 3's regional total disagrees with Annex 4's
rules.G1_rate_consistency: A growth rate recomputed from the level it belongs to must match the published rate
rules.G2_duplicate_series: Two different series carrying identical values (a reading list: sometimes a copy error, sometimes method)
rules.G3_jump: An unusually large change (a reading list, not a hold)
rules.G4_adds_up: The parts must add up to the published total
rules.G5_total_in_slot: An annual total sitting in a quarterly or monthly slot
rules.X1_time_sum: A year must equal the sum of its quarters or months; a quarter the sum of its months
rules.X2_same_figure: The same figure printed in two GSS tables must agree
rules.X3_share_of_gdp: A '% of GDP' figure must match the value divided by GSS's own GDP
rules.FX1_outlier: Far from the trading days around it: compared with the median of the five valid days before and after. Other currencies are compared through their rate against the US dollar, so a move of the cedi itself never counts
rules.FX2_spread: The buying rate is above the selling rate
rules.FX3_mid: The mid-rate is not halfway between the buying and selling rates (beyond rounding)
rules.FX4_weekend: Dated on a Saturday or Sunday
rules.FX5_statsbank: The month's average of BoG's daily mid-rates differs from GSS StatsBank's monthly interbank rate by more than StatsBank's rounding
rules.W1_positive: A price or index of zero or less
rules.W2_jump: Doubled or halved since the month before
rules.W3_imf_brent: The World Bank's Brent price is more than 5% from the IMF's for the same month
rules.W4_excel_error: The workbook has an Excel error (such as #VALUE!) where a value should be

breaks: GHSXOF, GHSGMD, GHSMRO, GHSNGN and GHSSLL: from July 2007 BoG quotes units of the foreign currency per cedi; before that the same codes carry old cedis per unit. Established from the table itself: only this reading keeps the implied US-dollar cross rates continuous across the switch. Not documented by BoG, so TARIN does not publish these five pairs before July 2007.

The cedi was redenominated on 1 July 2007: GH¢1 = ¢10,000. BoG's daily table carries old cedis (¢) up to 27 June 2007 and new cedis (GH¢) from 9 July 2007. TARIN divides the earlier values by 10,000 for a continuous series.
Currency Redenomination Act, 2006 (Act 724); Bank of Ghana

GHSSLL changes from old leones (SLL) to new leones (SLE = 1,000 SLL) on 11 September 2026: 2,109.39 on 10 Sep, 2.1082 on 11 Sep, with the implied dollar rate unchanged. Sierra Leone redenominated on 1 July 2022. TARIN expresses the whole series per new leone.
Bank of Sierra Leone (1 SLE = 1,000 SLL, 1 July 2022); BoG's table
